newsitem.title: USA: Two arrested for alleged extortion of Cosby- report.
newsitem.headline: Two arrested for alleged extortion of Cosby- report.

text.p: A woman claiming to be Bill Cosby's illegitimate daughter and a 54-year-old man have been arrested for allegedly attempting to extort $40 million from the entertainer, ABC News reported on Monday.

The network, quoting unidentified sources and an FBI affidavit it had obtained, said the couple, both from the Los Angeles area, were arrested on Saturday in the New York offices of a law firm representing Cosby.
ABC said there was no evidence the case was connected to the murder of Cosby's son adding that the alleged extortion attempt had been going on for some time.
But the network said the two had continued to make their demands via faxes and telephone calls even after the murder last week
Ennis Cosby, the 27-year-old son of the famed entertainer, was killed by an unidentified gunman early last Thursday morning while changing a flat tire along a southern California freeway.
An FBI spokesman declined to comment on the ABC report and Cosby's publicist was not immediately available for comment.
